releases.title: Safer login
notes: Login now also asks for the last 4 digits of your parent's registered mobile number, with your roll number and date of birth.
You stay logged in for 12 hours, then log in again. Your marks and fee details are now private to you and your parents.

releases.title: Safer login
notes: Your child's marks, attendance and fee details can now be opened only after you log in with the roll number and registered mobile number.
You stay logged in for 12 hours, then log in again.

releases.title: Faster test creation
notes: Paste questions copied from Word, WhatsApp, a PDF, Excel or an AI chat, and the app reads them.
Upload a CSV file from Excel, with a sample file to download.
Ask ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to write the questions: the app prepares the request in the right format.

releases.title: Online tests
notes: Design multiple choice tests, set the time and marks, and publish them to your class.
See every student's marks, rank and time taken, and let a student retake if needed.

releases.title: Online tests
notes: Each test is a card with the subject, time, marks and start time. The arrow opens once the test starts.
You verify your details before the questions appear. If you leave the test screen, your answers and verification are erased.
After you submit, you see which answers were right and which were wrong.

releases.title: Test reports
notes: See your child's online tests on the Test Reports card.
After your child submits, you see the score and which answers were right or wrong.

releases.title: Notifications
notes: A notification bell at the top. A blinking red dot means a new notice, a new test or an app update.

releases.title: Notifications and profile editing
notes: A notification bell at the top. A blinking red dot means a new notice, a new test or an app update.
Edit your child's profile with the pencil icon. The tuition office approves changes first.
Mother's name now shows in the child profile.

releases.title: Edit your profile
notes: Tap the pencil on My Profile to update your phone, email, address and other details.

releases.title: Profile editing and requests
notes: Edit your profile with the pencil icon at the top right.
Profile Requests: approve or reject profile changes that parents ask for.
Login Activity: delete one record, or clear them all.
